auditor: Claude Sonnet 5.5 via 16 read-only slice auditors and 3 re-audit readers, owner SerZhyAle

findings.summary: The SP-0183 rewrite did not parse ($pinned: scope reference), so every caller failed closed
findings.evidence: expected: the gate parses and passes a real payload and fails a damaged one | actual: pwsh 7 and Windows PowerShell 5.1 both exit 0 with 425 files identical to the pinned package on artifacts/smoke; artifacts/smoke-negative throws on different bytes

findings.summary: DisplaySettingsChanged handler touched the window off the dispatcher thread
findings.evidence: expected: window properties are read and written only on the dispatcher | actual: the handler marshals through Dispatcher.BeginInvoke and re-reads the panel there; re-audited clean, build 0 warnings, 1880 tests passed

findings.summary: The smoke verdict was not bound to the tagged commit (SP-0183 D2)
findings.evidence: expected: a smoke PASS for other code cannot unlock the build | actual: the step requires a full commit id that is an ancestor of HEAD with nothing changed outside release-verdicts/; re-audit R1 judged the logic correct, ReleaseWorkflowGateTests pass

findings.summary: Same finding as A1-1 seen from the verdict writer: the smoke verdict commit was unchecked
findings.evidence: expected: the smoke verdict commit is checked against the tagged tree | actual: checked in release.yml (see A1-1), re-audit R1 clean

findings.summary: The reference tree was wrong (build\libvlc\win-x64 does not exist in the package) and include and import libraries would have counted as missing
findings.evidence: expected: reference = the files the package targets ship (libvlc.*, libvlccore.*, hrtfs, lua, plugins) | actual: 425 files compared and identical; extra, missing and different-byte cases each throw (re-audit R1)

findings.summary: Abandoned-engine budget was per instance and never read, a faulted stop skipped Dispose, no log line
findings.evidence: expected: one budget across legs, refusal past the cap, contained release | actual: static shared budget, IsPaused checked in StartAsync, ReleaseContained on every exit, diagnostics through the log; EnginesNeverBlockSourceTests pins it; re-audit R2 clean

findings.summary: The chosen output device and channel mode were ignored by the FastMediaSorter route and by FlyleafLib
findings.evidence: expected: the choice covers every engine or the setting says which it does not | actual: FastMediaSorter route applies device and channel mode (new and live legs); the hint in all 13 languages states that the optional FlyleafLib engine uses the system default

findings.summary: The list-card Stop button carried a local Visibility=Collapsed that outranks the style trigger
findings.evidence: expected: Stop shows while the row plays | actual: local value removed, style setter collapses it, trigger shows it; re-audit R1 confirmed

findings.summary: Closing the window did not cancel its own download before disposing the clients
findings.evidence: expected: shutdown abandons the transfer and raises no dialog | actual: MainWindow_Closed cancels the operation, failure and success offers are guarded by _shuttingDown, merge and save keep CancellationToken.None; re-audit R2 clean

findings.summary: SP-0187 buttons used the out-of-theme exemption for decorative fills with sub-4.5:1 ink
findings.evidence: expected: palette roles, theme-following, no declared exception | actual: ten styles now set Foreground to InfoBrush, AccentMarkBrush, SuccessBrush, DangerBrush or WarningBrush on the ordinary control plate; ThemeColourDeclarationTests pass; re-audit R1 clean

findings.summary: AudioChannelMode had no tolerant converter; one unknown value made the whole state unreadable
findings.evidence: expected: an unreadable value costs one field | actual: TolerantEnumConverter registered, Load_UnreadableAudioChannelModeFallsBackToStereo added and green

findings.summary: Same finding as A15-1 seen from the converter list
findings.evidence: expected: converter present | actual: present before JsonStringEnumConverter; test green

findings.summary: GetRelativePath does not exist in Windows PowerShell 5.1
findings.evidence: expected: the gate runs under the host build.ps1 may use | actual: Substring-based paths; exit 0 under pwsh and powershell.exe on artifacts/smoke

findings.summary: A synchronous FastMediaSorter refusal could leave a resume record for a station never heard
findings.evidence: expected: the refusal arrives after the session is published | actual: await Task.Yield() before the refused result

findings.summary: The preview-artwork offer after a refresh was not guarded by _shuttingDown
findings.evidence: expected: no dialog during shutdown | actual: if (imported && !_shuttingDown)

findings.summary: Closing cancelled the non-cancellable merge and save phase of a refresh
findings.evidence: expected: shutdown cancels the transfer only | actual: CommitStateAsync takes CancellationToken.None
